meanings.en: about to happen soon, especially something unpleasant
meanings.exampleEn: There was a sense of impending disaster in the room.
meanings.exampleTr: Odada yaklaşan bir felaket hissi vardı.

meanings.en: a fault or a small flaw that makes something not perfect
meanings.exampleEn: The vase had a tiny imperfection on its surface.
meanings.exampleTr: Vazonun yüzeyinde küçük bir kusur vardı.

meanings.en: not allowing a liquid or gas to pass through
meanings.exampleEn: The container is made from an impermeable material.
meanings.exampleTr: Kap, geçirimsiz bir malzemeden yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: rude and not showing respect, especially to someone older or senior
meanings.exampleEn: It was impertinent of him to question his manager like that.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdürünü öyle sorgulaması onun küstahlığıydı.

meanings.en: showing a lack of respect for God or religion
meanings.exampleEn: His impious remarks about the church shocked the congregation.
meanings.exampleTr: Kiliseyle ilgili saygısız sözleri cemaati şoke etti.

meanings.en: showing a playful desire to cause mild trouble
meanings.exampleEn: She gave an impish grin before hiding his keys.
meanings.exampleTr: Anahtarlarını saklamadan önce muzip bir sırıtış attı.

meanings.en: the quality of being hard to believe or unlikely to be true
meanings.exampleEn: The implausibility of his excuse was obvious to everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Mazeretinin inanılmazlığı herkes için açıktı.

meanings.en: difficult to believe or unlikely to be true
meanings.exampleEn: The plot of the film was highly implausible.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin konusu son derece inandırıcılıktan uzaktı.

meanings.en: in a way that is hard to believe
meanings.exampleEn: The house was implausibly cheap for that neighbourhood.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev, o mahalle için inanılmayacak kadar ucuzdu.

meanings.en: rude behaviour or a lack of good manners
meanings.exampleEn: She apologised for the impoliteness of her earlier comment.
meanings.exampleTr: Daha önceki yorumunun kabalığı için özür diledi.

meanings.en: to a degree that is extremely difficult or seemingly impossible
meanings.exampleEn: The deadline was impossibly tight.
meanings.exampleTr: Teslim tarihi imkânsız derecede sıkışıktı.

meanings.en: the fact of being impossible to do or carry out in practice
meanings.exampleEn: The impracticability of the plan soon became clear.
meanings.exampleTr: Planın uygulanamazlığı kısa sürede belli oldu.

meanings.en: the quality of not being sensible or realistic to do
meanings.exampleEn: He pointed out the impracticality of driving there in one day.
meanings.exampleTr: Oraya bir günde arabayla gitmenin pratik olmadığını belirtti.

meanings.en: a lack of exactness or accuracy
meanings.exampleEn: The imprecision of the measurements caused errors in the results.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölçümlerin kesin olmayışı sonuçlarda hatalara yol açtı.

meanings.en: a lack of care or good judgement about the consequences of an action
meanings.exampleEn: His financial imprudence left the company in debt.
meanings.exampleTr: Onun mali tedbirsizliği şirketi borç içinde bıraktı.

meanings.en: the tendency to act suddenly without thinking about the results
meanings.exampleEn: Her impulsiveness sometimes got her into trouble.
meanings.exampleTr: Ani davranışlılığı bazen başını derde sokuyordu.

meanings.en: before a particular time or event
meanings.exampleEn: Please book your tickets in advance.
meanings.exampleTr: Lütfen biletlerinizi önceden ayırtın.

meanings.en: having the same opinion as someone else
meanings.exampleEn: We are all in agreement about the new schedule.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni programla ilgili hepimiz hemfikiriz.

meanings.en: in a state of disagreement or opposition
meanings.exampleEn: His views were in conflict with those of his colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Görüşleri meslektaşlarınınkiyle çatışma halindeydi.

meanings.en: in a situation where harm or death is possible
meanings.exampleEn: The rare species is now in danger of extinction.
meanings.exampleTr: Nadir tür artık yok olma tehlikesiyle karşı karşıya.

meanings.en: including many facts or particulars
meanings.exampleEn: She explained the process in detail.
meanings.exampleTr: Süreci ayrıntılı olarak açıkladı.

meanings.en: having a different opinion from someone else
meanings.exampleEn: The two economists were in disagreement about the forecast.
meanings.exampleTr: İki ekonomist tahmin konusunda anlaşmazlık içindeydi.

meanings.en: in a state of agreement or peaceful coexistence
meanings.exampleEn: The two communities have lived in harmony for centuries.
meanings.exampleTr: İki topluluk yüzyıllardır uyum içinde yaşıyor.

meanings.en: in a real situation, as opposed to in theory
meanings.exampleEn: The idea sounds good, but in practice it rarely works.
meanings.exampleTr: Fikir kulağa hoş geliyor ama uygulamada nadiren işe yarıyor.

meanings.en: physically fit and healthy
meanings.exampleEn: She runs every morning to stay in shape.
meanings.exampleTr: Formda kalmak için her sabah koşuyor.

meanings.en: used to introduce a short statement of the main points
meanings.exampleEn: In summary, the project was a success.
meanings.exampleTr: Özetle, proje bir başarıydı.

meanings.en: the state of not being good enough or sufficient
meanings.exampleEn: The report highlighted the inadequacy of the current system.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor, mevcut sistemin yetersizliğini vurguladı.

meanings.en: a feeling that one is not good enough
meanings.exampleEn: He struggled with feelings of inadequacy at work.
meanings.exampleTr: İşte yetersizlik duygularıyla mücadele ediyordu.

meanings.en: not done on purpose; accidental
meanings.exampleEn: An inadvertent error in the data led to the wrong conclusion.
meanings.exampleTr: Verilerdeki kasıtsız bir hata yanlış sonuca yol açtı.

meanings.en: not wise or sensible to do; likely to cause problems
meanings.exampleEn: It is inadvisable to travel there without a guide.
meanings.exampleTr: Oraya rehbersiz seyahat etmek tavsiye edilmez.

meanings.en: the fact of not being relevant or unable to be applied to a situation
meanings.exampleEn: The court noted the inapplicability of the old rule to this case.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkeme, eski kuralın bu davaya uygulanamazlığına dikkat çekti.

meanings.en: not relevant or unable to be used in a particular situation
meanings.exampleEn: This regulation is inapplicable to small businesses.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu düzenleme küçük işletmelere uygulanamaz.

meanings.en: the inability to express oneself clearly in speech
meanings.exampleEn: His inarticulacy made the interview painful to watch.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini ifade edemeyişi röportajı izlemeyi zorlaştırdı.

meanings.en: lacking artistic taste, skill, or quality
meanings.exampleEn: The critics found the design dull and inartistic.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler tasarımı sıkıcı ve sanattan yoksun buldu.

meanings.en: a failure to pay attention to something
meanings.exampleEn: The accident was caused by a moment of inattention.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaza, bir anlık dikkatsizlik yüzünden oldu.

meanings.en: the state of not paying attention or not being attentive
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher was frustrated by the students' inattentiveness.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen, öğrencilerin dikkatsizliğinden dolayı bunaldı.

meanings.en: in a way that cannot be heard
meanings.exampleEn: She muttered something inaudibly under her breath.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendi kendine duyulmayacak şekilde bir şeyler mırıldandı.

meanings.tr: iş göremez hale gelmiş, güçten düşmüş
meanings.en: unable to work or function normally, especially because of illness or injury
meanings.exampleEn: He was incapacitated for weeks after the accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Kazadan sonra haftalarca iş göremez haldeydi.

meanings.en: the lack of ability or power to do something
meanings.exampleEn: His illness led to a temporary incapacity to work.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalığı, geçici olarak iş göremez hale gelmesine yol açtı.

meanings.en: a person who represents a particular quality in a physical form
meanings.exampleEn: She was the very incarnation of kindness.
meanings.exampleTr: O, iyiliğin vücut bulmuş haliydi.

meanings.en: a particular period of someone's or something's existence or form
meanings.exampleEn: In its latest incarnation, the company sells software.
meanings.exampleTr: En son halinde şirket yazılım satıyor.

meanings.en: without stopping; continuously
meanings.exampleEn: The dog barked incessantly all night.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek bütün gece durmadan havladı.

meanings.en: to encourage or stir up violent or unlawful behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for trying to incite a riot.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir ayaklanmayı kışkırtmaya çalıştığı için tutuklandı.

meanings.en: rude or impolite behaviour
meanings.exampleEn: The manager would not tolerate incivility among the staff.
meanings.exampleTr: Müdür, personel arasında kabalığı hoş görmezdi.

meanings.en: having as a part; used to introduce something that is part of a larger group
meanings.exampleEn: Everyone came to the party, including my boss.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkes partiye geldi, patronum dahil.

meanings.en: so good or great that nothing can be compared to it
meanings.exampleEn: The view from the summit was of incomparable beauty.
meanings.exampleTr: Zirveden görülen manzara eşsiz bir güzellikteydi.

meanings.en: not leading to a firm decision or clear result
meanings.exampleEn: The test results were inconclusive.
meanings.exampleTr: Test sonuçları kesin değildi.
